items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: my music teacher, Mrs. Hewey, would always -- was always telling me, 'Well, Hayes, I'm going to make you learn because you have it in you.'

ctx.x: And I used to sing in the Glee Club in high school. And then they had me singing with a group of girls, and they put me right in the middle. And at that time I was supposed to have had a pretty nice voice. And my music teacher, Mrs. Hewey, would always -- was always telling me, "Well, Hayes, I'm going to make you learn because you have it in you." You know how kids would play a lot, you know. But she would tell me, "I'm going to make you learn this, Hayes, because you have it in you." One of those kind of things.
So, I knew a little about vocal music. A little bit, you know, man.
